Both Fentanyl and Alfentanil are synthetic opioids and full agonists at the opioid receptor used as analgesic agents and as an adjunct to induction and anaesthesia 

+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
|                              | **Fentanyl**                                        | **Alfentanil**                               |
+==============================+=====================================================+==============================================+
| **Dose equivalence/Potency** | 150mcg                                              | 1mg                                          |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **Onset/Peak **              | Rapid onset \~30s, peak effect \~5min               | Rapid onset \~30sec and peak effect \~1-2min |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **Distribution**             | 8.4 10% unionised at pH 7.4                         | 6.5 90% unionised at pH 7.4                  |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
| pKa                          | 6x more lipid soluble then Alfentanil               | 90%                                          |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
| Lipid Solubility             | 85%                                                 | 0.6l/kg                                      |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
| Protein Binding              | 4l/kg                                               |                                              |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
| Vd                           |                                                     |                                              |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **Clearance**                | 13ml/kg/min                                         | 6ml/kg/min                                   |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **Metabolism **              | Significant first pass pulmonary endothelial uptake | Hepatic metabolism to inactive metabolites   |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
|                              | Hepatic Metabolism to inactive metabolites          |                                              |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **Elimination**              | renal excretion                                     | renal excretion                              |
|                              |                                                     |                                              |
| **Elimination t1/2b**        | 2-4hrs                                              | 1.5hrs                                       |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| **CSHT (4hr infusion)**      | 3.5hours                                            | 1hr                                          |
+------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
